context: The pegs are A, B, and C from left to right. Move all three disks from A to C. Each move transfers one top disk, and a larger disk cannot sit on a smaller one. The peg contents below are listed from bottom to top.

Green represents the large disk, blue the medium disk, and orange the small disk. A solid teal outline groups the medium and small disks into a size-two subproblem, f(2). Each disk must still move separately.
description: Four frames show the starting point and the end of each stage. Each f(2) stage takes three legal one-disk moves, with one move of the large disk between them, for a total of seven. Player step numbers count frames rather than cumulative disk moves.

frames.announcement: Treat the top two disks on A as a subproblem of size two.
frames.explanation: Initially A=[large disk, medium disk, small disk], B=[], and C=[]. No move has been made. To uncover the large bottom disk, first transfer the medium and small disks inside the teal outline from A to B. In this f(2) subproblem, B is the destination and C is the auxiliary peg.
frames.key_state: No moves yet. From bottom to top, A holds the large, medium, and small disks. B and C are empty.
frames.title: Treat the top two disks as a subproblem

frames.announcement: Using peg C, transfer the top two disks from A to B in three one-disk moves.
frames.explanation: In the first f(2) stage, A is the source, C the auxiliary peg, and B the destination. Move the small disk A→C, the medium disk A→B, and the small disk C→B. Three one-disk moves are complete. Now A=[large disk], B=[medium disk, small disk], and C=[]. The teal outline moves to B with the medium and small disks. The frame shows the end of the stage, omitting the three individual moves.
frames.key_state: Three one-disk moves are complete. A holds the large disk. B holds the medium disk below the small disk. C is empty.
frames.title: Complete the two-disk subproblem from A to B

frames.announcement: Move the remaining disk, the largest, directly from A to C.
frames.explanation: The two smaller disks are on B. The large disk on A is exposed, and C is empty, so move it from A to C. Now A=[], B=[medium disk, small disk], and C=[large disk]. Four one-disk moves are complete. The teal outline still surrounds the medium and small disks on B.
frames.key_state: Four one-disk moves are complete. A is empty, B holds the medium disk below the small disk, and C holds the large disk.
frames.title: Move the largest disk from A to C

frames.announcement: Using A, transfer the two disks from B to C in three more one-disk moves. The seventh move completes the transfer.
frames.explanation: In the second f(2) stage, B is the source, A the auxiliary peg, and C the destination. Move the small disk B→A, the medium disk B→C, and the small disk A→C. Now A=[], B=[], and C=[large disk, medium disk, small disk]. Seven one-disk moves complete the transfer. The teal outline surrounds the medium and small disks on C.
frames.key_state: Seven one-disk moves are complete. A and B are empty, and C holds the large, medium, and small disks from bottom to top. The transfer is complete.
frames.title: Complete the two-disk subproblem from B to C

summary: Move the top two disks to B, move the largest disk to C, then move the two disks from B to C. These three stages take seven one-disk moves in all.
title: Divide and conquer for the three-disk Tower of Hanoi
